info.title: Okrika Books API
info.description: API for managing book listings, authentication, cart, wishlist, and orders for the Okrika Books platform.

post.summary: Changes the password for the authenticated admin user.

requestBody.description: The current and new password details.

post.summary: Completes an admin password reset using an OTP.

requestBody.description: The email, OTP, and new password.

post.summary: Initiates an admin password reset by sending an OTP to the admin's email.

requestBody.description: The admin's email address.

post.summary: Authenticates an admin user and returns a JWT token.

requestBody.description: The login credentials.

post.summary: Creates a new book category.

requestBody.description: The category details.

post.summary: Updates an existing category.

requestBody.description: The updated category details.

delete.summary: Deletes a category by its ID.

get.summary: Retrieves a category by its ID.

post.summary: Approves a pending listing, making it visible to users.
Declines a pending listing.

requestBody.description: The rejection details containing the reason.

get.summary: Retrieves listings for admin review, with optional filtering and pagination.
Retrieves a listing by its ID for admin review.

post.summary: Changes the password for the currently authenticated user.

requestBody.description: The current and new password details.

post.summary: Completes a password reset using the OTP sent to the user's email.

requestBody.description: The email, OTP, and new password.

post.summary: Initiates a password reset by sending an OTP to the user's email.

requestBody.description: The user's email address.

post.summary: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token.

requestBody.description: The login credentials.

post.summary: Registers a new user account.

requestBody.description: The sign-up details.

post.summary: Verifies a user's email address using an OTP.

requestBody.description: The email and OTP verification details.

post.summary: Resends the email verification OTP to the user's email.

requestBody.description: The user's email address.

get.summary: Retrieves the current user's cart with all items.

post.summary: Adds an item to the user's cart.

requestBody.description: The book ID and quantity to add.

post.summary: Adds multiple items to the user's cart in a single request.

requestBody.description: List of book IDs and quantities to add.

post.summary: Validates the current cart items (e.g. checks stock availability and pricing).

delete.summary: Removes an item from the user's cart.

post.summary: Submits a new book listing for approval.

requestBody.description: The listing details including book information and pricing.

post.summary: Updates an existing listing.

requestBody.description: The updated listing details.

get.summary: Retrieves published listings matching the specified filter criteria.
Retrieves a specific listing by its ID.

post.summary: Enables or disables the discount on a listing. Only the listing owner can perform this action.

requestBody.description: The discount toggle flag.

get.summary: Retrieves the currently logged-in user's listings, with optional filtering.
Retrieves a specific listing owned by the current user, regardless of status or published state.
Returns a summary of the current user's listings: total, active published, and pending approval counts.
Retrieves the current user's wishlist with all saved items.

post.summary: Adds a book to the user's wishlist.

requestBody.description: The book ID to add to the wishlist.

delete.summary: Removes a book from the user's wishlist.
